the design of a feed system that is compact, low cost, and well suited for multi-antenna satellite communications.
the development of a wide-band feed chain system for dual-band single polarized antennas.
the design of a compact dual-band feed for single circular polarization with a single feed for each of the beams in a multi-beam antenna.

the presented feed chain is a very promising solution for dual-band multi-beam satellite applications.

a wide-band compact feed for dual-band multi-beam satellite communication is designed, simulated and analyzed.
we have developed a new feed chain solution for dual-band single polarization with a wide-band compact design and a high performance.
